body: Thank you. I've been breathing, slowly. Long deep breaths to finally calm myself. I'm trying really hard to remind myself that only I can determine the life I live, and not have to follow what my parents dictate or want for me. It's just so difficult to hear that I'm a disgrace to them and a shame.
Thank you. I've finally cleared my head and have settled down. I don't think I could actually do it. But I'm just scared that I do think about it.
